description: Every open zone's lifecycle runs, not only the newest 60 (s6-v5, s6-ote-v5, s6-ob-v7; audit mechanism M9, owner ruling 2026-09-14). The lifecycles read the bounded list_live (newest MAX_ZONES for scoring), so older zones were never advanced or expired and back-wrote transitions hundreds of candles late. Each mutation points one lifecycle read back at list_live. Deterministic tests, so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/lifecycles_read_every_open_zone.json
